claims.population: The Local Government Area covers an area of 3,687 km2 and had a population of 493,810 in 2006.
claims.emirate: Bauchi is the administrative center of Bauchi State, of the Bauchi Local Government Area within that State, and of the traditional Bauchi Emirate.
claims.burial: Abubakar Tafawa Balewa is buried in the city.
claims.economy: With the coming of the railway in 1961, Bauchi grew as a collecting point for peanuts (groundnuts) and cotton and a trade centre in sorghum, millet, cowpeas, corn (maize), cassava, and vegetables and in cattle, goats, and sheep.
claims.crafts: Cotton weaving and dyeing, tanning, and blacksmithing are traditional activities.
claims.education: Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University (1980; originally called Federal University of Technology) and a Federal Polytechnic are in the town.
claims.climate: According to the Köppen Climate Classification system, Bauchi has a tropical savanna climate, abbreviated "Aw" on climate maps.
